title: Localizing Persona Representations in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2505.24539v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a study on how and where personas -- defined by distinct sets of human characteristics, values, and beliefs -- are encoded in the representation space of large language models (LLMs). Using a range of dimension reduction and pattern recognition methods, we first identify the model layers that show the greatest divergence in encoding these representations. We then analyze the activations within a selected layer to examine how specific personas are encoded relative to others, including their shared and distinct embedding spaces. We find that, across multiple pre-trained decoder-only LLMs, the analyzed personas show large differences in representation space only within the final third of the decoder layers. We observe overlapping activations for specific ethical perspectives -- such as moral nihilism and utilitarianism -- suggesting a degree of polysemy. In contrast, political ideologies like conservatism and liberalism

translated_title: 定位大语言模型中的人格表征
translated_abstract: 我们开展了一项研究，探究人格——由独特的人类特征、价值观和信念集合所定义——在大语言模型（LLM）的表征空间中如何以及在何处被编码。利用多种降维和模式识别方法，我们首先识别出在编码这些表征时表现出最大分歧的模型层。随后，我们分析了所选层内的激活情况，以考察特定人格相对于其他人格是如何被编码的，包括它们共享和独特的嵌入空间。我们发现，在多个预训练的仅解码器（decoder-only）大语言模型中，所分析的人格仅在解码器最后三分之一的层中才在表征空间中显示出显著差异。我们观察到某些特定伦理观点——如道德虚无主义和功利主义——的激活存在重叠，这表明存在一定程度的多义性。相比之下，保守主义和自由主义等政治意识形态
tldr: 本研究通过降维和模式识别方法定位了大语言模型中人格表征的编码位置，发现不同人格仅在解码器最后三分之一的层中呈现显著表征差异，且部分伦理观点（如道德虚无主义与功利主义）的激活存在重叠，暗示表征具有多义性。
en_tdlr: This study localizes persona representations in LLMs, finding that personas diverge significantly in representation space only within the final third of decoder layers, with overlapping activations for certain ethical perspectives suggesting a degree of polysemy.
